$comment: The machine-readable twin of contracts/hafnia/README.md. `internal/vlm` reads
neither file: the client is built against the ASSUMPTIONS below, and this
document exists so a reader can tell an assumption from a verified fact
`status` is the whole point of this file. It is `asserted` because no live
call has been made; `pocctl preflight` prints it, and `pocctl vlm-probe`
records the raw response under contracts/hafnia/raw/ and a human flips these
Rows whose wrongness fails LOUDLY (a 404, a 401) are the cheap ones. Row 6,
the region host, is the expensive one, and the README explains why.

superseded_hosts.note: Published by an earlier revision of the documentation without the eu. label. Recorded, not dialled; internal/vlm/regionHosts does not contain it and a test asserts that.

auth.note: Bearer is what the root platform's client sends and it is a 401 on every call.

response.consequence: The region is measured locally by internal/novelty and the model is never asked for coordinates. This is the assumption the architecture rests on.

attribution.model_identity: what the API said; a claim by the provider
attribution.contract_version: a content hash over the prompt, its revision, the output schema version, the API model name and the region
attribution.output_hash: the content hash of the validated four-field output
attribution.model_hash_note: Deliberately absent. A hosted model has no weights to hash, and a synthetic hash satisfies a column check while defeating the only thing the column is for.

raw_responses: contracts/hafnia/raw/ — empty until a live call is made
